name: Leads
description: One row per merchant/business lead: brand, category, city, store count, est. monthly revenue, lead source, data verifiability, funnel stage, rejection reason, notes (JSON array), and stage history (JSON array). Score/score_breakdown/suggested_action are never stored — they are pure/derived from these fields plus the fund's scoring_criteria and recomputed on every read. Stage moves, rejections, and notes are written directly by the human sourcing-team operator in the kanban board — this is a direct-manipulation control panel, not a review/approval queue

agentPrompts.label: Move a lead to its next stage
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then advance the lead I name to its next funnel stage (New → Data-Verified → Scored → Term-Sheet-Ready) and append a stage-history entry. This is a direct kanban write, not an approval queue — never send outreach, sign a term sheet, or move money.

agentPrompts.label: Reject a lead with a reason
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then move the lead I name to rejected with the reason I give you, storing it on the lead and in stage-history. A rejection always requires a reason.

agentPrompts.label: Add a note to a lead
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then append the note I give you to the lead I name as a timestamped entry, without changing its stage.

agentPrompts.label: Explain this lead's score
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-lead-funnel` skill in this folder, then show the lead's deterministic 0-100 score broken down by factor (chain-size fit, revenue-scale fit, category risk, data verifiability) with each factor's weight, contribution, and rationale, plus the suggested next action. The score is rule-based, never an LLM call — do not editorialize beyond the computed breakdown.
